description: Drug shortage check (FDA) — Is a drug in shortage right now? Searches the FDA drug shortage list by generic or brand name and returns each affected product and presentation with status (current, resolved, to be discontinued), availability, shortage reason, company, therapeutic category, first posted and last updated dates. With no drug, lists the newest shortage updates. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

drug.description: generic or brand name, e.g. amoxicillin (optional)

name: fda_shortages
